column2:
pad(n./v.)墊子、便條本、填塞
padding(n.)填充物
mouse pad 滑鼠墊
knee pad 護膝
He wrote the phone number on a note pad.
(他把電話號碼寫在便條本上。)
Skaters should wear knee pads for safety.
(溜冰的人應該戴護膝以策安全。)

painter(n.)畫家、油漆工
paint(v./n.)畫、油漆
painting(n.)畫作
famous painter 著名畫家
house painter 油漆工
Van Gogh is one of my favorite painters.
(梵谷是我最喜歡的畫家之一。)
We hired a painter to paint the walls.
(我們請了一位油漆工來粉刷牆壁。)

pal(n.)朋友、夥伴(口語)
(無詞性變化)
pen pal 筆友
old pal 老朋友
I have a pen pal in Canada.
(我在加拿大有一位筆友。)
Mike and I have been pals since childhood.
(麥克和我從小就是好朋友。)

palace(n.)宮殿
(無詞性變化)
royal palace 皇宮
the National Palace Museum 國立故宮博物院
The king lived in a beautiful palace.
(國王住在一座美麗的宮殿裡。)
We visited the National Palace Museum last weekend.
(我們上週末參觀了國立故宮博物院。)

palm(n.)手掌、棕櫚樹
(無詞性變化)
palm tree 棕櫚樹
read one's palm 看手相
Palm trees line the beach road.
(海灘路旁種滿了棕櫚樹。)
She held the tiny bird in her palm.
(她把那隻小鳥捧在手掌心。)

pancake(n.)鬆餅、煎餅
(無詞性變化)
make pancakes 做鬆餅
pancake with syrup 淋糖漿的鬆餅
Dad makes pancakes every Sunday morning.
(爸爸每個星期天早上都做鬆餅。)
I like my pancakes with honey and butter.
(我喜歡在鬆餅上加蜂蜜和奶油。)

panic(n./v.)恐慌、驚慌
panicky(adj.)驚慌的
in a panic 驚慌失措
Don't panic. 別慌。
People ran out of the building in a panic.
(人們驚慌失措地跑出大樓。)
Don't panic if you forget a word in your speech.
(演講時忘詞也別慌張。)

parade(n./v.)遊行、列隊行進
(無詞性變化)
hold a parade 舉行遊行
parade float 遊行花車
Thousands of people watched the holiday parade.
(數千人觀看了節日遊行。)
The team paraded through the city after winning.
(球隊獲勝後在城市中遊行。)

paradise(n.)天堂、樂園
(無詞性變化)
shopping paradise 購物天堂
a paradise for 對⋯來說是天堂
This island is a paradise for divers.
(這座島是潛水者的天堂。)
Taipei is a food paradise for tourists.
(台北對觀光客來說是美食天堂。)

parcel(n./v.)包裹、分配
(無詞性變化)
send a parcel 寄包裹
parcel out 分配
I went to the post office to send a parcel.
(我去郵局寄包裹。)
A parcel arrived for you this morning.
(今天早上有一個你的包裹寄到了。)

parrot(n./v.)鸚鵡、鸚鵡學舌般地重複
(無詞性變化)
pet parrot 寵物鸚鵡
parrot fashion 死記硬背地
Our pet parrot can say 'hello'.
(我們的寵物鸚鵡會說「哈囉」。)
Don't just parrot the textbook; use your own words.
(不要只是照著課本背，要用自己的話說。)

passage(n.)通道、(文章的)段落、流逝
pass(v.)通過
reading passage 閱讀短文
the passage of time 時間的流逝
Read the passage and answer the questions.
(閱讀這篇短文並回答問題。)
A narrow passage leads to the garden.
(一條狹窄的通道通往花園。)

passenger(n.)乘客
(無詞性變化)
passenger seat 副駕駛座
passenger train 客運列車
The bus can carry fifty passengers.
(這輛公車可以載五十名乘客。)
All passengers must wear seat belts.
(所有乘客都必須繫安全帶。)

passion(n.)熱情、熱愛
passionate(adj.)熱情的
have a passion for 熱愛⋯
follow your passion 追隨你的熱情
She has a passion for music.
(她熱愛音樂。)
He spoke about science with great passion.
(他充滿熱情地談論科學。)

passport(n.)護照
(無詞性變化)
apply for a passport 申請護照
passport control 護照查驗處
Don't forget to bring your passport.
(別忘了帶你的護照。)
You need a passport to travel abroad.
(出國旅行需要護照。)

pat(v./n.)輕拍
(無詞性變化)
pat someone on the back 拍某人的背(表示鼓勵)
give... a pat 輕拍⋯
The coach patted me on the back after the game.
(比賽後教練拍拍我的背鼓勵我。)
She gave the dog a gentle pat.
(她輕輕拍了拍那隻狗。)

patience(n.)耐心
patient(adj./n.)有耐心的、病人
patiently(adv.)耐心地
lose patience 失去耐心
with patience 有耐心地
Learning a language takes patience.
(學習語言需要耐心。)
The teacher never loses patience with us.
(老師對我們從不失去耐心。)

pause(n./v.)暫停、停頓
(無詞性變化)
pause button 暫停鍵
a short pause 短暫的停頓
She paused for a moment before answering.
(她回答之前停頓了一下。)
Press the pause button to stop the video.
(按暫停鍵讓影片停下來。)

pave(v.)鋪(路)、pavement(n.)人行道、鋪過的路面
(無詞性變化)
pave the way for 為⋯鋪路
paved road 柏油路
The village road was paved last year.
(那條村莊道路去年鋪好了。)
Hard work paves the way for success.
(努力為成功鋪路。)

pea(n.)豌豆
(無詞性變化)
green peas 青豆
like two peas in a pod 一模一樣
He doesn't like green peas.
(他不喜歡吃青豆。)
The twins are like two peas in a pod.
(那對雙胞胎長得一模一樣。)

peanut(n.)花生
(無詞性變化)
peanut butter 花生醬
roasted peanuts 烤花生
I had a peanut butter sandwich for lunch.
(我午餐吃了一份花生醬三明治。)
Some people can't eat peanuts.
(有些人不能吃花生。)

pearl(n.)珍珠
(無詞性變化)
pearl necklace 珍珠項鍊
pearl milk tea 珍珠奶茶
She wore a pearl necklace to the party.
(她戴著一條珍珠項鍊參加派對。)
Pearl milk tea is popular around the world.
(珍珠奶茶在全世界都很受歡迎。)

peel(v./n.)剝皮、削皮、果皮
peeler(n.)削皮器
peel an apple 削蘋果皮
orange peel 橘子皮
Can you peel the potatoes for me?
(你可以幫我削馬鈴薯皮嗎？)
Don't throw the banana peel on the floor.
(別把香蕉皮丟在地上。)

penguin(n.)企鵝
(無詞性變化)
emperor penguin 皇帝企鵝
a group of penguins 一群企鵝
Penguins cannot fly, but they swim well.
(企鵝不會飛，但很會游泳。)
We saw cute penguins at the zoo.
(我們在動物園看到可愛的企鵝。)

penny(n.)一分錢、便士
(無詞性變化)
every penny 每一分錢
not a penny 一毛錢也沒有
He saved every penny for a new phone.
(他為了買新手機存下每一分錢。)
The old toy isn't worth a penny.
(這個舊玩具一毛錢也不值。)

pepper(n.)胡椒、辣椒、甜椒
peppery(adj.)胡椒味的、辛辣的
salt and pepper 鹽和胡椒
green pepper 青椒
Add some salt and pepper to the soup.
(在湯裡加一些鹽和胡椒。)
My little brother refuses to eat green peppers.
(我弟弟拒絕吃青椒。)

perform(v.)表演、執行、表現
performance(n.)表演、表現
performer(n.)表演者
perform a task 執行任務
perform well 表現良好
The band will perform at the school festival.
(那個樂團將在校慶表演。)
Our team performed well in the contest.
(我們隊在比賽中表現良好。)

performance(n.)表演、表現、性能
perform(v.)表演、執行
performer(n.)表演者
live performance 現場表演
academic performance 學業表現
Her performance in the play was amazing.
(她在那齣戲中的表演很驚人。)
Sleep can affect your academic performance.
(睡眠會影響你的學業表現。)

permission(n.)許可、允許
permit(v.)允許
ask for permission 請求許可
without permission 未經許可
You need permission to leave the classroom.
(你需要得到許可才能離開教室。)
Don't use my computer without permission.
(未經許可不要用我的電腦。)

permit(v./n.)允許、許可證
permission(n.)許可
weather permitting 天氣允許的話
work permit 工作許可證
Smoking is not permitted in the building.
(大樓內禁止吸菸。)
We will go hiking, weather permitting.
(天氣允許的話，我們會去爬山。)

persuade(v.)說服
persuasion(n.)說服
persuasive(adj.)有說服力的
persuade... to 說服⋯去做
persuade... into 說服⋯做
I persuaded my dad to buy a dog.
(我說服爸爸買一隻狗。)
She tried to persuade him to stay, but he left.
(她試著說服他留下，但他還是走了。)

photographer(n.)攝影師
photograph(n./v.)照片、拍照
photography(n.)攝影
professional photographer 專業攝影師
wedding photographer 婚禮攝影師
The photographer took pictures of the wedding.
(攝影師拍攝了婚禮的照片。)
He wants to become a nature photographer.
(他想成為一名自然生態攝影師。)

pigeon(n.)鴿子
(無詞性變化)
feed the pigeons 餵鴿子
racing pigeon 賽鴿
Children are feeding the pigeons in the park.
(孩子們在公園裡餵鴿子。)
A pigeon landed on my window.
(一隻鴿子停在我的窗台上。)

pile(n./v.)一堆、堆積
(無詞性變化)
a pile of 一堆
pile up 堆積
There is a pile of books on my desk.
(我書桌上有一堆書。)
Dirty dishes piled up in the sink.
(髒碗盤在水槽裡堆積如山。)

pill(n.)藥丸
(無詞性變化)
take a pill 吃藥丸
sleeping pill 安眠藥
Take one pill after each meal.
(每餐飯後吃一顆藥。)
The pill was too big to swallow.
(那顆藥丸大到難以吞下。)

pilot(n./v.)飛行員、駕駛、試驗性的(計畫)
(無詞性變化)
airline pilot 民航機師
pilot program 試辦計畫
My cousin wants to be an airline pilot.
(我表哥想當民航機師。)
The pilot landed the plane safely.
(機師讓飛機安全降落。)

pine(n.)松樹
(無詞性變化)
pine tree 松樹
pine cone 松果
Tall pine trees grow on the mountain.
(山上長著高大的松樹。)
The kids collected pine cones in the forest.
(孩子們在森林裡撿松果。)

pineapple(n.)鳳梨
(無詞性變化)
pineapple cake 鳳梨酥
pineapple juice 鳳梨汁
Pineapple cakes are a popular gift from Taiwan.
(鳳梨酥是台灣很受歡迎的伴手禮。)
This pineapple is sweet and juicy.
(這顆鳳梨又甜又多汁。)

pint(n.)品脫(容量單位)
(無詞性變化)
a pint of milk 一品脫牛奶
half a pint 半品脫
He bought a pint of milk at the store.
(他在店裡買了一品脫牛奶。)
A pint is a little less than half a liter.
(一品脫比半公升少一點。)

pit(n.)坑、洞、(水果的)核
(無詞性變化)
fire pit 火坑、烤火台
peach pit 桃核
The workers dug a deep pit.
(工人們挖了一個深坑。)
Be careful not to swallow the cherry pit.
(小心別吞下櫻桃核。)

pitch(n./v.)投球、音調、球場、搭(帳篷)
pitcher(n.)投手、水壺
pitch a tent 搭帳篷
high pitch 高音調
We pitched our tent near the lake.
(我們在湖邊搭帳篷。)
He pitched the ball very fast.
(他把球投得很快。)

pity(n./v.)遺憾、同情、憐憫
pitiful(adj.)可憐的
What a pity! 真可惜！
take pity on 同情⋯
What a pity that you missed the concert!
(你錯過了演唱會真可惜！)
I pity the people who lost their homes.
(我同情那些失去家園的人。)

plastic(n./adj.)塑膠、塑膠的
(無詞性變化)
plastic bag 塑膠袋
plastic surgery 整形手術
Please bring your own bag instead of using plastic bags.
(請自備購物袋，不要使用塑膠袋。)
Plastic waste is harmful to sea animals.
(塑膠垃圾對海洋動物有害。)

playful(adj.)愛玩的、開玩笑的
play(v.)玩
playfully(adv.)開玩笑地、頑皮地
playful puppy 愛玩的小狗
playful mood 頑皮的心情
The playful kitten chased the ball all day.
(那隻愛玩的小貓整天追著球跑。)
He gave her a playful smile.
(他對她露出頑皮的微笑。)

plenty(pron./n./adv.)大量、充足、很
plentiful(adj.)豐富的
plenty of 很多的
plenty of time 充裕的時間
Don't worry, we have plenty of time.
(別擔心，我們時間很充裕。)
Drink plenty of water on hot days.
(大熱天要多喝水。)

plug(n./v.)插頭、塞子、插上插頭
(無詞性變化)
plug in 插上電源
pull the plug 拔掉插頭、終止
Plug in the charger before you go to bed.
(睡前先把充電器插上電源。)
The sink plug is missing.
(水槽的塞子不見了。)

pole(n.)竿、柱、(地球的)極
polar(adj.)極地的
the North Pole 北極
fishing pole 釣竿
A bird is sitting on the telephone pole.
(一隻鳥停在電線桿上。)
Polar bears live near the North Pole.
(北極熊住在北極附近。)

political(adj.)政治的
politics(n.)政治
politician(n.)政治人物
political party 政黨
political issue 政治議題
Taiwan has several major political parties.
(台灣有幾個主要政黨。)
They avoid talking about political issues at dinner.
(他們吃飯時避免談論政治議題。)

politician(n.)政治人物、政客
politics(n.)政治
political(adj.)政治的
local politician 地方政治人物
honest politician 誠實的政治人物
The politician promised to build a new park.
(那位政治人物承諾要建一座新公園。)
Many people don't trust politicians.
(很多人不信任政客。)

politics(n.)政治、政治學
political(adj.)政治的
politician(n.)政治人物
enter politics 從政
be interested in politics 對政治感興趣
My uncle has been interested in politics since college.
(我叔叔從大學起就對政治很感興趣。)
She plans to study politics at university.
(她打算在大學念政治學。)

poll(n./v.)民意調查、投票、對⋯進行民調
(無詞性變化)
opinion poll 民意調查
go to the polls 去投票
The latest poll shows he is in the lead.
(最新的民調顯示他領先。)
We polled fifty students about their lunch habits.
(我們針對五十名學生的午餐習慣做了調查。)

pollute(v.)汙染
pollution(n.)汙染
polluted(adj.)受汙染的
pollute the air 汙染空氣
polluted water 受汙染的水
Factories should not pollute the rivers.
(工廠不應該汙染河川。)
Cars pollute the air in big cities.
(汽車汙染了大城市的空氣。)

pollution(n.)汙染
pollute(v.)汙染
polluted(adj.)受汙染的
air pollution 空氣汙染
noise pollution 噪音汙染
Air pollution is bad for our health.
(空氣汙染對我們的健康有害。)
We should reduce plastic pollution in the ocean.
(我們應該減少海洋中的塑膠汙染。)

porcelain(n.)瓷器、瓷
(無詞性變化)
porcelain vase 瓷花瓶
fine porcelain 精緻瓷器
The museum has a collection of Chinese porcelain.
(博物館收藏了一批中國瓷器。)
She broke a porcelain cup by accident.
(她不小心打破了一個瓷杯。)

portion(n./v.)部分、一份、分配
(無詞性變化)
a large portion of 大部分的
a portion of food 一份食物
The restaurant serves large portions.
(這家餐廳的份量很大。)
A large portion of my money goes to food.
(我大部分的錢都花在食物上。)

portrait(n.)肖像、人像畫
portray(v.)描繪
self-portrait 自畫像
portrait painter 肖像畫家
A portrait of the king hangs on the wall.
(牆上掛著一幅國王的肖像。)
The artist painted a self-portrait.
(那位畫家畫了一幅自畫像。)

poster(n.)海報
(無詞性變化)
movie poster 電影海報
put up a poster 張貼海報
He has a movie poster on his bedroom wall.
(他臥室牆上貼著一張電影海報。)
We put up posters for the school concert.
(我們為學校音樂會張貼海報。)

postpone(v.)延期、postponement(n.)延期
(無詞性變化)
postpone the meeting 延後會議
postpone until 延到⋯
The game was postponed because of the typhoon.
(比賽因颱風而延期。)
We had to postpone our trip until next month.
(我們不得不把旅行延到下個月。)

pottery(n.)陶器、陶藝
potter(n.)陶藝家
make pottery 做陶藝
pottery class 陶藝課
We made pottery bowls in art class.
(我們在美術課做了陶碗。)
Yingge is famous for its pottery.
(鶯歌以陶瓷聞名。)

pour(v.)倒、灌、(雨)傾盆而下
(無詞性變化)
pour water 倒水
pour down 傾盆而下
Could you pour me a glass of water?
(你可以幫我倒一杯水嗎？)
It is pouring outside, so take an umbrella.
(外面正下著大雨，帶把傘吧。)

poverty(n.)貧窮
poor(adj.)貧窮的
live in poverty 生活貧困
poverty line 貧窮線
Many children around the world live in poverty.
(全世界有許多孩子生活在貧困中。)
Education can help people escape poverty.
(教育能幫助人們擺脫貧窮。)

powder(n./v.)粉、粉末、撲粉
powdery(adj.)粉狀的
milk powder 奶粉
washing powder 洗衣粉
Mix the milk powder with warm water.
(把奶粉和溫水混合。)
The baking powder makes the cake rise.
(泡打粉讓蛋糕膨脹起來。)

practical(adj.)實際的、實用的
practice(n./v.)實踐、練習
practically(adv.)實際上、幾乎
practical skills 實用技能
practical advice 實用的建議
This bag is cheap and practical.
(這個包包便宜又實用。)
She gave me some practical advice.
(她給了我一些實用的建議。)

precious(adj.)珍貴的、寶貴的
(無詞性變化)
precious time 寶貴的時間
precious stone 寶石
Time with family is precious.
(和家人相處的時光很寶貴。)
Don't waste your precious time on games.
(不要把寶貴的時間浪費在遊戲上。)

preparation(n.)準備
prepare(v.)準備
prepared(adj.)準備好的
in preparation for 為⋯做準備
make preparations 做準備
The students are busy in preparation for the exam.
(學生們正忙著準備考試。)
Good preparation is the key to success.
(充分的準備是成功的關鍵。)

presence(n.)出席、在場、存在
present(adj.)出席的、現在的
in the presence of 在⋯面前
presence of mind 沉著、鎮定
Thank you for your presence at the meeting.
